name: Use of Uninitialized Variable
principle: Code reads a variable before a value is definitely assigned on every path. The value may be stack junk, a stale heap value, or a security-relevant default, causing unpredictable control flow, crashes, data exposure, or bypass.
detection_signals: C/C++ automatic variable declaration like `int x;` or `char *p;` followed by a read on a path with no prior assignment
`switch` assigns a variable in `case` blocks, then uses it after the switch, with missing `default` or a `default` that assigns the wrong variable
Variable assigned only inside `if`, `else if`, loop, or `try` block and read after the block without an `else`/fallback assignment
`sscanf`, `scanf`, `fscanf`, or `strtol` output variables are used without checking the function return/count before use
Uninitialized C string buffer or pointer passed to `printf("%s")`, `strlen`, `strcat`, `strcmp`, or similar null-terminated string API
C++ class primitive member or pointer member missing from all constructors' initializer lists and later read
PHP variable assigned only under `isset($_POST[...])`, `isset($_GET[...])`, or `array_key_exists(...)` and later accessed unconditionally
negative_signals: Variable is initialized at declaration, e.g. `int x = 0;`, `char *p = NULL;`, `char buf[N] = "";`
Every `if`/`else` branch and every `switch` case including `default` assigns the variable before use
`sscanf`/`scanf` return value is compared to the expected assignment count before using output variables
C++ constructor initializer list initializes every primitive, pointer, and security-state member
Use site is dominated by an early `return`, `throw`, or error path when initialization fails
Java local variable use is accepted by the compiler only after definite assignment
false_defense_traps: Relying on debug builds or allocator patterns that fill stack/heap memory with predictable bytes
Assuming automatic C/C++ local variables are zero-initialized
Checking that input exists but leaving the destination variable unset when the check fails
Adding a `default` case that does not assign all variables used after the `switch`
Initializing only the pointer variable while the pointed-to buffer contents remain uninitialized
verification_focus: Can any control-flow path reach the read/API call with the variable not definitely assigned a valid value?

consequence_chains.trigger: Initialization is missing on one branch and the variable is later read
consequence_chains.consequence: Undefined or unintended value affects program behavior

consequence_chains.trigger: `sscanf`/`scanf` return value is not checked before using output variables
consequence_chains.consequence: Failed parse leaves variables uninitialized and used in security logic

consequence_chains.trigger: Uninitialized lock or state flag is tested as if valid
consequence_chains.consequence: Synchronization or authorization check may be skipped

patch_principle: Initialize critical variables at declaration with a safe default value.
Ensure all control-flow branches assign the variable or fail closed before the read.
Check parser/input API return values before using output variables.
Initialize C/C++ strings and buffers and guarantee null termination before string-library calls.
Enable compiler warnings such as `-Wuninitialized` and `-Wmaybe-uninitialized` and treat them as errors.

minimal_examples.vuln: int ok; if (is_admin(user)) ok = 1; if (ok) grant_access();
minimal_examples.safe: int ok = 0; if (is_admin(user)) ok = 1; if (ok) grant_access();
